t_advice_summary_textbox.text: i need to work out 3 colours that give good rewards in each round and stick with them, and only change if the points start dropping consistently, and start again for each round

vb_textbox.text: The aim of the game is to try to identify which coloured gnomes give you the most amount of mushrooms, but as soon as you start to see the amount of points awarded dropping, then it is best to change and try to work out which one now gives the most points, you will start fresh again at the beginning of each new round. Goodluck.
